behavior: All three sources automatically fill missing fields; textbook content remains authoritative when populated.
Chinese characters generate pinyin locally; missing English or Chinese use the existing translation service.
Image/custom source editors begin on idle or blur without a completion button.
Generated-field provenance persists across source, confirmation and draft round trips; edits invalidate only stale generated values.
Leaving cached views cancels source requests and rejects late responses; returning resumes missing fields.
Translation fallback accepts only exact-source, correct-direction candidates scoring at least .99 when the primary result is invalid.
limitations: Automatic translation is a candidate, not a claim to reproduce the original textbook wording.
OCR can still confuse week and Weak; free/up have context-sensitive meanings.
finalProductionAcceptance: passed with documented OCR and translation accuracy limitations
